goal: Build an original Lum demon character base with real textures, humanoid rig, facial expressions and bounded secondary motion while keeping the Samsung runtime offline and provenance-safe.
sourceLaw: AI proposes. Policy authorizes. CI proves. Human promotes.

referenceStyle.copyrightRule: reference informs original design only; no franchise character cloning

baseDonor.name: VRoid Base Female
baseDonor.licenseEvidence: tools/scripts/avatar-catalog.json in donor repository + embedded VRM metadata
baseDonor.role: primary textured anime humanoid donor for Atelier preview and retargeting

faceRigReference.copyPolicy: reimplement LuHm runtime contracts; do not bundle non-CC0 example avatars

falloutCommunityReferences.restriction: do not copy GPL implementation into the Android runtime without an explicit compatible licensing decision
no Bethesda game data or third-party mod meshes/textures are redistributed

runtimePhysics.hair: Godot SpringBoneSimulator3D or vetted MIT wiggle modifier on dedicated hair chains
runtimePhysics.chestSecondaryMotion: dedicated helper bones only; never deform the whole torso skeleton as a soft body
runtimePhysics.wings: spring-bone skeletal frame; optional SoftBody3D membrane experiment behind mobile quality gate
runtimePhysics.cloth: SoftBody3D only for isolated cloth/membrane meshes and only after Samsung performance proof

targetRig.face: VRM expressions now; ARKit-52 plus Oculus visemes preferred for authored final base
